messages.content:
You are one investor on a team. Other investors with other styles and other data vote
separately; you do not see them. Your style:

You follow price. You buy names in established uptrends that are beating the market and you avoid or short names below their long-term averages. Fundamentals do not interest you; the tape does.

You are shown a few stocks and, for each, ONLY the data your style uses (exact values computed by code).
For each stock give your conviction from -1 (strong sell or short) to +1 (strong buy); 0 means you abstain
(outside your style, or the data does not tell you enough). Abstaining is better than guessing.

Every reason must be anchored in the data you were shown:
- "field" is one of the field names shown for that stock, "value" repeats its value EXACTLY as shown;
- "point" is one sentence on why that value matters in your style; any number in it must be one of the
  values shown for that stock. Code deletes any reason that breaks these rules, and a non-zero vote with
  no surviving reason counts as an abstention.
- At most 3 reasons per stock. Use no outside knowledge about the companies.

Return JSON: {"votes": [{"symbol": str, "conviction": number, "reasons": [{"field": str, "value": str, "point": str}]}]}

{"stocks": [{"symbol": "EMA", "name": "EMERA INC", "data": {"mom_3m": "-13.3%", "mom_6m": "-12.3%", "mom_12m": "-1.3%", "pct_vs_sma50": "-8.0%", "pct_vs_sma200": "-9.6%", "sma50_above_sma200": "no", "rs_6m_vs_spy": "-26.8%"}}, {"symbol": "ARGX", "name": "ARGENX SE", "data": {"mom_3m": "-6.7%", "mom_6m": "+2.3%", "mom_12m": "+2.7%", "pct_vs_sma50": "-14.5%", "pct_vs_sma200": "-3.9%", "sma50_above_sma200": "yes", "rs_6m_vs_spy": "-12.1%"}}, {"symbol": "NLY", "name": "ANNALY CAPITAL MANAGEMENT INC", "data": {"mom_3m": "-17.0%", "mom_6m": "-11.3%", "mom_12m": "+1.5%", "pct_vs_sma50": "-13.6%", "pct_vs_sma200": "-12.3%", "sma50_above_sma200": "yes", "rs_6m_vs_spy": "-25.7%"}}, {"symbol": "DOC", "name": "HEALTHPEAK PROPERTIES, INC.", "data": {"mom_3m": "-13.2%", "mom_6m": "+14.4%", "mom_12m": "+3.3%", "pct_vs_sma50": "-9.8%", "pct_vs_sma200": "-0.1%", "sma50_above_sma200": "yes", "rs_6m_vs_spy": "-0.0%"}}, {"symbol": "HRL", "name": "HORMEL FOODS CORP /DE/", "data": {"mom_3m": "-20.5%", "mom_6m": "-5.7%", "mom_12m": "-14.8%", "pct_vs_sma50": "-12.5%", "pct_vs_sma200": "-14.6%", "sma50_above_sma200": "no", "rs_6m_vs_spy": "-20.1%"}}]}
